Model: gpt-image-2.5（使用 gpt-image-2.5 生图模型）
Story CG for a Southern Song wuxia game. One finished full-colour illustration, fully opaque and painted right to all four edges, with no vignette and no dark or faded border.

Input 1 = an approved CG of this game: copy its painting style exactly (refined paper-texture wuxia illustration, natural faces, restrained light and shadow, fine lines, matte paper feel). Do not copy its subject.
Input 2 = the approved pencil sketch: keep this composition and staging. The old man stands on the left, the youth on the right, the wrapped book case is the centre of the picture, the boat is small in the mist at upper right. Do not copy its grey colouring, its dark edges or its clothing details.
Input 3 = Lin, the old man's official portrait: his face, grey short beard and headcloth must match it. He is a real, plain old fortune-teller, with no fake beard, no glue marks, no hanging strings and no smeared ash.
Input 4 = Xiao Bai's official portrait: his face, modern short black hair and borrowed plain village clothes must match it.
Input 5 = close-up of Lin's left hand: his little finger is missing its upper half and ends in a healed short stump. Paint the hand that way.

Moment: a riverside ferry landing in a village, early morning, soft pale mist, cool grey-green water and weathered wooden posts.
Left, Lin: his old grey fortune-teller's robe, worn for many years and neatly mended, is half untied at the chest, showing a dark ink-purple inner edge. He has a slight appreciative smile and looks at the youth. His right hand holds out a wrapped book case of dark blue brocade, a closed rectangular case with bone clasps and no writing on it. His raised left hand holds a small old bronze lamp token by its cord, close to his chest, with the short little-finger stump clearly visible against the token.
Right, Xiao Bai: both hands have just taken the far edge of the book case. His expression is surprised and a little relieved. He looks at the case and at Lin.
Far background, small in the mist: one boat with one boatman at the stern holding a pole, only a soft silhouette.

Rules: exactly two main figures, plus the tiny boatman. Check every arm: shoulder, upper arm, elbow, forearm, wrist and hand are continuous, with five clearly separate digits on each hand except for Lin's shortened little finger. The two men's faces must look clearly different from each other. No torn rags, frayed strips, ragged hems or tattered cloth anywhere. No lanterns, signs, text, seals, watermark, UI or frame.
Framing for 16:9 landscape: leave a little empty air above both heads. Keep both faces, the book case and all hands inside the upper 72% of the frame. The bottom quarter must be only quiet robe folds and plain wooden planks, with nothing important, because subtitles go there.
OUTPUT: ONE 1536x1024 opaque image.
